message:
You know those moments when you feel a bit smug, like a cat that just caught the red dot? 😏 Last week, while packing our go-bags, I found myself thinking of all the times I suggested we keep them ready. My partner rolled their eyes, but that day, as we faced an unexpected thunderstorm, I was the one with the last laugh! 

We had water, snacks, and even our important documents all set to go. It felt good to be prepared, and it reminded us that it’s not just about the stuff—it’s about peace of mind and being ready together. 

Have you had a moment like that recently?
